verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is inherently a headless background-jobs platform: tasks run via SDK/CLI with no UI required, deploys are triggered from CI via a documented GitHub Actions workflow, and the CLI supports local dev, build, and cloud deploy commands suitable for automation pipelines. Community evidence corroborates real production/CI usage (e.g. long-term customers running it as an async backend for their apps).  Missing for 10: no explicit third-party proof of arbitrary CI providers beyond GitHub Actions, and no example of fully non-interactive CLI use for run-triggering/testing in CI.
